storyCards.headline: Stand Or Fall: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Fixx's "Stand Or Fall" reached #76 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Stand or Fall" is a song by new wave/rock band the Fixx, released by MCA Records in the UK on 26 March 1982, followed by a US release on 5 August 1982.

The song peaked at #76 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 8 weeks on the chart.

Stand Or Fall was released in 1982.
